key_claims: Strains have surfaced between the Taliban and Bin Ladin over his calls for violence against Americans.
Taliban leadership is debating whether to continue giving Bin Ladin safehaven.
Mullah Omar earlier expressed dissatisfaction with Bin Ladin's high visibility.
The Taliban has given no indication it plans to expel Bin Ladin.
